in_marathi.name: Kadam
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Banyan tree seed
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kadam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Kadam refers to the seed of the banyan tree, symbolizing the beginning of life and new opportunities. The banyan tree is considered sacred in Hinduism and is a symbol of strength, stability, and longevity.
